question:
In the given figure, if n || m and m ∠a ∶ m∠b = 2: 3, then what is m∠h?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76d91d058fd3780cce21fe0535eb951372bd36ca27727fc5f8bb87f36603abf9.png]
solution:
**Given:**

n || m and m ∠a ∶ m∠b = 2: 3

**Concept Used:**

Angles on straight lines sums to 180° which is also known as Linear Pair.

When two parallel lines are crossed by another line, the pairs of angles formed on opposite sides of the crossing line but outside the parallel lines are always equal.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76d91d058fd3780cce21fe0535eb951372bd36ca27727fc5f8bb87f36603abf9.png] 

In the given figure,

⇒ m∠a + m∠b = 180° (Linear Pair)

Let the value of m∠a and m∠b be 2x and 3x respectively.

⇒ 2x + 3x = 180

⇒ 5x = 180

⇒ x = 36

⇒ m∠a = 2 × 36 = 72° 

⇒ m∠b = 3 × 36 = 108° 

Now, 

⇒ m∠h = m∠b (Alternate exterior angles)

⇒ m∠h = 108° 

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
